title.value: M ASAKHA NEWS: N EWS T OPIC C LASSIFICATION FOR A FRICAN LANGUAGES
title.justification: The title clearly states the focus on news topic classification for African languages, under the project name 'MasakhaNEWS'.
title.quote: Title of the paper: M ASAKHA NEWS: N EWS T OPIC C LASSIFICATION FOR A FRICAN LANGUAGES

extractions.description: This paper presents MasakhaNEWS, a benchmark dataset for news topic classification in 16 African languages. It addresses the challenge of limited NLP datasets for African languages by developing a large, annotated collection of news articles. It evaluates various machine learning models and techniques, including zero-shot and few-shot learning, to improve NLP tasks for these under-represented languages.

sustainable_development_is_central.justification: The paper addresses significant challenges related to language diversity and access to information in African languages, aligning with sustainable development goals that promote inclusive societies and education through improved linguistic resources.
sustainable_development_is_central.quote: In this paper, we develop MasakhaNEWS — a new benchmark dataset for news topic classification covering 16 languages widely spoken in Africa.

primary_category.justification: The primary theme of the paper is its contribution to developing NLP resources for African languages, which supports the Global South by improving data access and linguistic inclusion.
primary_category.quote: African languages are severely under-represented in NLP research due to lack of datasets covering several NLP tasks.

secondary_categories.justification: The paper does not directly address other sustainable development categories beyond improving linguistic resources for African languages.

primary_sub_category.justification: The paper focuses on support for data utilization in the Global South, specifically through the development and benchmarking of NLP datasets for African languages.
primary_sub_category.quote: We create MasakhaNEWS — a large-scale news topic classification dataset covering 16 typologically-diverse languages widely spoken in Africa.

secondary_sub_categories.justification: There are no additional secondary sub-categories since the paper specifically focuses on data support for linguistic resources.

applications.value: Enhancing NLP capabilities for African languages
applications.justification: The major contribution of the paper is enhancing NLP capabilities for African languages through the development of the MasakhaNEWS dataset and evaluation of various learning models.
applications.quote: We provide an evaluation of baseline models by training classical machine learning models and fine-tuning several language models.

new_primary_category.justification: The existing sustainable development category 'Support to Global South' adequately describes the paper's focus.

new_primary_sub_category.justification: The existing sub-category 'Climate Data' fits well in the context of support to linguistic resource development in Africa.
